name: run_id
meaning: The name of the run, the grid cell name of ntk_lib.cell_name.

name: alpha
meaning: The laziness knob alpha of the rescaled predictor alpha (f - f_0).
source: Kumar et al. (2024), Appendix 8.1, Equation 7, arXiv v3

name: width
meaning: The hidden width N.

name: eta_kappa
meaning: The weight decay as the product of learning rate and decay, eta lambda in the report.
source: docs/report.tex, The laziness and weight-decay knobs

name: seed
meaning: The model seed. The data seed is 42 for every run.

name: step
meaning: The checkpoint step.

name: log10_step1
meaning: Base 10 logarithm of the step plus one.

name: dt_prev
meaning: Steps since the previous checkpoint. NaN at step 0.

name: on_linear_grid
meaning: True if the step is a multiple of the linear checkpoint interval of 1,000 steps.

name: on_log_grid
meaning: True if the step is one of the log-spaced checkpoints.

name: wall_seconds
meaning: Wall-clock seconds since the run started. It depends on the machine and the load.

name: train_loss
meaning: Mean squared error of the predictor on the train set.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: train_acc
meaning: Accuracy of the predictor on the train set, by the largest output.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: test_loss
meaning: Mean squared error of the predictor on the test set.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: test_acc
meaning: Accuracy of the predictor on the test set, by the largest output.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: train_margin_mean
meaning: Mean over the train set of the correct output minus the largest other output.

name: train_margin_min
meaning: Smallest margin over the train set.

name: train_correct_out_mean
meaning: Mean output at the correct class on the train set. The MSE target there is one.

name: train_wrong_out_rms
meaning: Root mean square output at the wrong classes on the train set. The MSE target there is zero.

name: train_out_rms
meaning: Root mean square of all outputs on the train set, the output scale.

name: train_out_max_mean
meaning: Mean over the train set of the largest output.

name: test_margin_mean
meaning: Mean over the test set of the correct output minus the largest other output.

name: test_margin_min
meaning: Smallest margin over the test set.

name: test_correct_out_mean
meaning: Mean output at the correct class on the test set. The MSE target there is one.

name: test_wrong_out_rms
meaning: Root mean square output at the wrong classes on the test set. The MSE target there is zero.

name: test_out_rms
meaning: Root mean square of all outputs on the test set, the output scale.

name: test_out_max_mean
meaning: Mean over the test set of the largest output.

name: grad_norm
meaning: Norm of the gradient of the training loss, without the decay term.

name: grad_norm_W1
meaning: Norm of the gradient of the training loss with respect to W1.

name: grad_norm_W2
meaning: Norm of the gradient of the training loss with respect to W2.

name: update_norm
meaning: Norm of the next gradient-descent step, decay included.
formula: lr ||g + wd theta|| with lr = eta_0 / alpha^2 and wd = eta_kappa / lr

name: grad_weight_cos
meaning: Cosine between the loss gradient and the weights. Near minus one at a point where decay and gradient cancel.

name: grad_decay_ratio
meaning: Size of the loss gradient over the size of the decay pull. NaN without decay.

name: decay_residual
meaning: How far the gradient and the decay pull are from cancelling. Zero at a fixed point of gradient descent with decay, one when the two are orthogonal.

name: stationary
meaning: True if the run has decay and decay_residual is below 0.001.

name: sharpness
meaning: Largest eigenvalue of the Hessian of the training loss, without the decay term, by 20 power iterations with Hessian-vector products, warm started.

name: lr_sharpness
meaning: Learning rate times sharpness. Gradient descent on a quadratic with this curvature is stable when it is below 2.

name: weight_norm
meaning: Norm of all the parameters.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: param_dist
meaning: Relative parameter movement.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: log_weight_norm_ratio
meaning: Log of the weight norm over its value at step 0. The kernel of a 2-homogeneous network rescaled by c has norm c^2 times larger, so twice this value is the scale term a uniform rescaling of the weights would give.

name: W1_norm
meaning: Frobenius norm of W1.

name: W1_dist
meaning: Relative movement of W1.

name: W1_stable_rank
meaning: Stable rank of W1.

name: W1_eff_rank
meaning: Effective rank of W1, the exponential of the entropy of its singular values normalised to sum to one.
formula: exp(-sum q log q), q = sigma / sum sigma

name: W2_norm
meaning: Frobenius norm of W2.

name: W2_dist
meaning: Relative movement of W2.

name: W2_stable_rank
meaning: Stable rank of W2.

name: W2_eff_rank
meaning: Effective rank of W2, the exponential of the entropy of its singular values normalised to sum to one.
formula: exp(-sum q log q), q = sigma / sum sigma

name: layer_imbalance
meaning: Difference of the squared layer norms over the squared total norm. Gradient flow without decay keeps ||W1||^2 - ||W2||^2 fixed for this bias-free ReLU network. With decay it shrinks by (1 - eta_kappa)^2 per step, so it mostly records decay.

name: dead_frac
meaning: Fraction of hidden units that are inactive on every training input.

name: active_frac
meaning: Mean over training inputs of the fraction of hidden units that are active.

name: fourier_W_a_topshare
meaning: Mean over hidden units, weighted by the unit's norm, of the share of nonzero-frequency power at the unit's largest frequency, for the a-half of W1 along the token axis, in the weights. Frequencies k and p - k are folded together.
formula: sum_i w_i max_k P_ik / sum_k P_ik / sum_i w_i
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_W_a_neff
meaning: Effective number of nonzero frequencies in the pooled power of the a-half of W1 along the token axis, in the weights.
formula: exp(entropy of sum_i P_ik / sum_ik P_ik)
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_W_a_dcshare
meaning: Share of the power at frequency zero for the a-half of W1 along the token axis, in the weights.
formula: sum_i P_i0 / sum_ik P_ik over all k

name: fourier_W_b_topshare
meaning: Mean over hidden units, weighted by the unit's norm, of the share of nonzero-frequency power at the unit's largest frequency, for the b-half of W1 along the token axis, in the weights. Frequencies k and p - k are folded together.
formula: sum_i w_i max_k P_ik / sum_k P_ik / sum_i w_i
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_W_b_neff
meaning: Effective number of nonzero frequencies in the pooled power of the b-half of W1 along the token axis, in the weights.
formula: exp(entropy of sum_i P_ik / sum_ik P_ik)
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_W_b_dcshare
meaning: Share of the power at frequency zero for the b-half of W1 along the token axis, in the weights.
formula: sum_i P_i0 / sum_ik P_ik over all k

name: fourier_W_c_topshare
meaning: Mean over hidden units, weighted by the unit's norm, of the share of nonzero-frequency power at the unit's largest frequency, for W2 along the class axis, in the weights. Frequencies k and p - k are folded together.
formula: sum_i w_i max_k P_ik / sum_k P_ik / sum_i w_i
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_W_c_neff
meaning: Effective number of nonzero frequencies in the pooled power of W2 along the class axis, in the weights.
formula: exp(entropy of sum_i P_ik / sum_ik P_ik)
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_W_c_dcshare
meaning: Share of the power at frequency zero for W2 along the class axis, in the weights.
formula: sum_i P_i0 / sum_ik P_ik over all k

name: fourier_W_match
meaning: Weighted fraction of hidden units whose largest frequency is the same for a, b and the output class, in the weights.
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_W_phase
meaning: Weighted mean of cos(phi_a + phi_b - phi_c) over the matched units, with the phases of the DFT at the shared frequency, in the weights. Equation 12 of Gromov (2023) makes this one for the exact solution. NaN if no unit matches.
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_dW_a_topshare
meaning: Mean over hidden units, weighted by the unit's norm, of the share of nonzero-frequency power at the unit's largest frequency, for the a-half of W1 along the token axis, in the change of the weights since step 0. Frequencies k and p - k are folded together.
formula: sum_i w_i max_k P_ik / sum_k P_ik / sum_i w_i
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_dW_a_neff
meaning: Effective number of nonzero frequencies in the pooled power of the a-half of W1 along the token axis, in the change of the weights since step 0.
formula: exp(entropy of sum_i P_ik / sum_ik P_ik)
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_dW_a_dcshare
meaning: Share of the power at frequency zero for the a-half of W1 along the token axis, in the change of the weights since step 0.
formula: sum_i P_i0 / sum_ik P_ik over all k

name: fourier_dW_b_topshare
meaning: Mean over hidden units, weighted by the unit's norm, of the share of nonzero-frequency power at the unit's largest frequency, for the b-half of W1 along the token axis, in the change of the weights since step 0. Frequencies k and p - k are folded together.
formula: sum_i w_i max_k P_ik / sum_k P_ik / sum_i w_i
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_dW_b_neff
meaning: Effective number of nonzero frequencies in the pooled power of the b-half of W1 along the token axis, in the change of the weights since step 0.
formula: exp(entropy of sum_i P_ik / sum_ik P_ik)
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_dW_b_dcshare
meaning: Share of the power at frequency zero for the b-half of W1 along the token axis, in the change of the weights since step 0.
formula: sum_i P_i0 / sum_ik P_ik over all k

name: fourier_dW_c_topshare
meaning: Mean over hidden units, weighted by the unit's norm, of the share of nonzero-frequency power at the unit's largest frequency, for W2 along the class axis, in the change of the weights since step 0. Frequencies k and p - k are folded together.
formula: sum_i w_i max_k P_ik / sum_k P_ik / sum_i w_i
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_dW_c_neff
meaning: Effective number of nonzero frequencies in the pooled power of W2 along the class axis, in the change of the weights since step 0.
formula: exp(entropy of sum_i P_ik / sum_ik P_ik)
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_dW_c_dcshare
meaning: Share of the power at frequency zero for W2 along the class axis, in the change of the weights since step 0.
formula: sum_i P_i0 / sum_ik P_ik over all k

name: fourier_dW_match
meaning: Weighted fraction of hidden units whose largest frequency is the same for a, b and the output class, in the change of the weights since step 0.
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: fourier_dW_phase
meaning: Weighted mean of cos(phi_a + phi_b - phi_c) over the matched units, with the phases of the DFT at the shared frequency, in the change of the weights since step 0. Equation 12 of Gromov (2023) makes this one for the exact solution. NaN if no unit matches.
source: Gromov (2023), arXiv:2301.02679v1, Equations 6, 7 and 12, as motivation

name: S_t
meaning: Scale term on the raw probe kernel.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: R_t
meaning: Rotation term on the raw probe kernel.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: K_norm
meaning: Frobenius norm of the raw probe kernel. K is the kernel of f, not of the rescaled predictor. With lr = eta_0 / alpha^2 the step in function space is eta_0 K at every alpha, so this can be compared across alpha.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: yKy
meaning: y^T K^+ y on the probe set, summed over the label columns.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: S_c
meaning: Scale term on the centred probe kernel.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section; ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: R_c
meaning: Rotation term on the centred probe kernel.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section; ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: A_t
meaning: Centred kernel-target alignment on the probe.
formula: <Kc_t, G> / (||Kc_t|| ||G||), G = H Y Y^T H
source: Cortes, Mohri and Rostamizadeh (2012), Definition 4; docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section; ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: A_u
meaning: Uncentred alignment on the probe.
source: ntk_lib.uncentred_alignment; ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: S_c_train
meaning: The scale term on the train part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those pairs.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section; ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: R_c_train
meaning: The rotation term on the train part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those pairs.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section; ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: A_t_train
meaning: The centred alignment on the train part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those pairs.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section; ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: A_u_train
meaning: The uncentred alignment on the train part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those pairs.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section; ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: S_c_test
meaning: The scale term on the test part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those pairs.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section; ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: R_c_test
meaning: The rotation term on the test part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those pairs.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section; ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: A_t_test
meaning: The centred alignment on the test part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those pairs.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section; ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: A_u_test
meaning: The uncentred alignment on the test part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those pairs.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section; ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: K_norm_centred
meaning: Frobenius norm of the centred probe kernel.
source: Cortes, Mohri and Rostamizadeh (2012), Lemma 1, for H K H; ntk_trace.Tracer.measure

name: inner_K0
meaning: Inner product of the centred kernel with the centred kernel at step 0.

name: inner_G
meaning: Inner product of the centred kernel with the centred target Gram matrix.

name: D
meaning: The usual kernel movement statistic on the centred kernel.

name: exp2S_term
meaning: First piece of Equation eq:decomp. D^2 = exp2S_term + 1 - cross_term.
source: docs/report.tex, Equation eq:decomp, the group's own algebra

name: cross_term
meaning: Last piece of Equation eq:decomp.
source: docs/report.tex, Equation eq:decomp, the group's own algebra

name: gamma
meaning: The aim: the cosine between the part of k_t orthogonal to k_0 and the part of the unit target orthogonal to k_0. NaN at step 0.
source: term_dependence.py docstring, the group's own algebra; ntk_trace.Tracer.measure

name: share_k0
meaning: Share of the squared change of the unit kernel along k_0. It equals R_c / 2.

name: share_gperp
meaning: Share of the squared change of the unit kernel along g_perp.

name: share_residual
meaning: Share of the squared change of the unit kernel orthogonal to both k_0 and g_perp. The three shares sum to one.

name: kernel_degenerate
meaning: True if the centred probe kernel norm is below 1e-30. The unit-kernel columns are then NaN.

name: S_W1
meaning: Scale term of the centred kernel term from the gradient of W1 alone.

name: R_W1
meaning: Rotation term of the centred kernel term from W1 alone.

name: A_W1
meaning: Centred alignment of the kernel term from W1 alone.

name: S_W2
meaning: Scale term of the centred kernel term from the gradient of W2 alone.

name: R_W2
meaning: Rotation term of the centred kernel term from W2 alone.

name: A_W2
meaning: Centred alignment of the kernel term from W2 alone.

name: W1_kernel_share
meaning: Share of the trace of the centred probe kernel that comes from W1.

name: S_first_logit
meaning: The scale term of the centred kernel of the first output alone. The report names this kernel as a robustness check.

name: R_first_logit
meaning: The rotation term of the centred kernel of the first output alone. The report names this kernel as a robustness check.

name: A_first_logit
meaning: The centred alignment of the centred kernel of the first output alone. The report names this kernel as a robustness check.

name: S_sum
meaning: Scale, the plain ratio of Frobenius norms to step 0, of the kernel of the sum of the logits divided by sqrt(p), on the test pairs of the run. These are the S_t, R_t, D_t and A_t of the golden report.

name: R_sum
meaning: Shape change, one minus the uncentred cosine to step 0, of the kernel of the sum of the logits divided by sqrt(p), on the test pairs of the run. These are the S_t, R_t, D_t and A_t of the golden report.

name: D_sum
meaning: Variation, the Frobenius norm of the change from step 0 over the norm at step 0, of the kernel of the sum of the logits divided by sqrt(p), on the test pairs of the run. These are the S_t, R_t, D_t and A_t of the golden report.

name: A_sum
meaning: Centred alignment with Y Y^T, of the kernel of the sum of the logits divided by sqrt(p), on the test pairs of the run. These are the S_t, R_t, D_t and A_t of the golden report.

name: eig_trace
meaning: Trace of the centred probe kernel.

name: eig_top1
meaning: Largest eigenvalue of the centred probe kernel.

name: eig_top1_share
meaning: Largest eigenvalue over the trace.

name: eig_eff_rank
meaning: Exponential of the entropy of the eigenvalues normalised to sum to one. The zero eigenvalue that centring creates is left out, and so is every column below.

name: eig_participation
meaning: Participation ratio of the eigenvalues.

name: eig_n90
meaning: Number of the largest eigenvalues that hold 90 percent of the trace.

name: eig_gap_ab
meaning: Ratio of eigenvalue 2(p - 1) to eigenvalue 2(p - 1) + 1, counting from one. In the tier x traces the functions of a alone and of b alone filled the top 2(p - 1) places.

name: eig_gap_top88
meaning: Ratio of eigenvalue 4(p - 1) to eigenvalue 4(p - 1) + 1, the edge of the eigenvectors that the tracking columns follow.

name: probe_energy_sum
meaning: Share of the trace of the centred probe kernel inside the centred functions of (a + b) mod p on the probe. The subspaces are not orthogonal on the probe, so the four shares need not sum to one. This is the label subspace.

name: probe_energy_diff
meaning: Share of the trace of the centred probe kernel inside the centred functions of (a - b) mod p on the probe. The subspaces are not orthogonal on the probe, so the four shares need not sum to one.

name: probe_energy_a
meaning: Share of the trace of the centred probe kernel inside the centred functions of a alone on the probe. The subspaces are not orthogonal on the probe, so the four shares need not sum to one.

name: probe_energy_b
meaning: Share of the trace of the centred probe kernel inside the centred functions of b alone on the probe. The subspaces are not orthogonal on the probe, so the four shares need not sum to one.

name: label_capture_22
meaning: Share of the centred label matrix inside the top 22 eigenvectors of the centred probe kernel.

name: label_capture_44
meaning: Share of the centred label matrix inside the top 44 eigenvectors of the centred probe kernel.

name: label_capture_88
meaning: Share of the centred label matrix inside the top 88 eigenvectors of the centred probe kernel.

name: topk_drift
meaning: Mean squared sine of the principal angles between the top 4(p - 1) eigenvectors and the same span at step 0. At large width the cut falls in a nearly degenerate bulk, so this is noisy there.

name: overlap_zero_median
meaning: Median over the tracked top eigenvectors of the absolute overlap with the step 0 vector their chain of matches leads back to. Noisy at large width for the same reason.

name: S_full
meaning: Scale term of the centred kernel on all p^2 pairs.

name: R_full
meaning: Rotation term of the centred kernel on all p^2 pairs.

name: A_full
meaning: Centred alignment on all p^2 pairs, with the labels of every pair.

name: full_energy_sum
meaning: Share of the trace of the centred full-grid kernel inside the centred functions of (a + b) mod p. On the full grid the four subspaces are orthogonal.

name: full_energy_diff
meaning: Share of the trace of the centred full-grid kernel inside the centred functions of (a - b) mod p. On the full grid the four subspaces are orthogonal.

name: full_energy_a
meaning: Share of the trace of the centred full-grid kernel inside the centred functions of a alone. On the full grid the four subspaces are orthogonal.

name: full_energy_b
meaning: Share of the trace of the centred full-grid kernel inside the centred functions of b alone. On the full grid the four subspaces are orthogonal.

name: full_energy_rest
meaning: Share of the trace of the centred full-grid kernel outside the four subspaces.

name: krr_full_test_acc
meaning: Accuracy of kernel ridge regression with the current kernel from the real training pairs to the real test pairs, starting from a zero function as the predictor does. The ridge is 0.001 times the mean diagonal of the training block.

name: krr_full_test_mse
meaning: Mean squared error of the same kernel ridge regression on the real test pairs.

name: krr_probe_test_acc
meaning: Accuracy of kernel ridge regression with the current kernel from the training part of the probe to its test part, starting from a zero function as the predictor does. The ridge is 0.001 times the mean diagonal of the training block.

name: krr_probe_test_mse
meaning: Mean squared error of the same kernel ridge regression on its test part.

name: dS_step
meaning: Change of the centred scale term over the next gradient-descent step, from a virtual step with the current gradient and decay, in float64.

name: dA_step
meaning: Change of the centred alignment over the next step, from the same virtual step.

name: R_step
meaning: Rotation of the centred unit kernel over the next step, from the same virtual step.

name: run_id
meaning: The name of the run, the grid cell name of ntk_lib.cell_name.

name: alpha
meaning: The laziness knob alpha.
source: Kumar et al. (2024), Appendix 8.1, Equation 7, arXiv v3

name: width
meaning: The hidden width N.

name: eta_kappa
meaning: The weight decay eta lambda.
source: docs/report.tex, The laziness and weight-decay knobs

name: seed
meaning: The model seed.

name: data_seed
meaning: The seed of the split of the pairs into training and test sets, 42 + seed.

name: lr
meaning: The learning rate eta_0 / alpha^2.

name: weight_decay
meaning: The decay coefficient eta_kappa / lr passed to torch.optim.SGD.

name: status
meaning: ok, diverged (the training loss stopped being finite) or failed (an exception).

name: error
meaning: The traceback of a failed run, empty otherwise.

name: diverged_step
meaning: The checkpoint at which the training loss was first not finite.

name: steps
meaning: The step budget.

name: last_step
meaning: The last recorded checkpoint.

name: n_checkpoints
meaning: The number of recorded checkpoints.

name: seconds
meaning: Wall-clock seconds for the run, logger included.

name: callback_seconds
meaning: Wall-clock seconds spent in the feature logger.

name: feature_version
meaning: dataset_features.FEATURE_VERSION when the run was made.

name: git_commit
meaning: The commit of the repository when the run was made.

name: git_dirty
meaning: True if repoduced-code had uncommitted changes when the run was made.

name: closed_form_check
meaning: Largest relative difference between the autograd and closed-form probe kernels at the first and last checkpoints.

name: init_weight_norm
meaning: Weight norm at step 0.

name: final_weight_norm
meaning: Weight norm at the last checkpoint.

name: weight_norm_growth
meaning: final_weight_norm / init_weight_norm.

name: A_t_final
meaning: A_t at the last checkpoint.

name: A_full_final
meaning: A_full at the last checkpoint.

name: S_c_final
meaning: S_c at the last checkpoint.

name: R_c_final
meaning: R_c at the last checkpoint.

name: train_acc_final
meaning: train_acc at the last checkpoint.

name: test_acc_final
meaning: test_acc at the last checkpoint.

name: train_loss_final
meaning: train_loss at the last checkpoint.

name: test_loss_final
meaning: test_loss at the last checkpoint.

name: A_0
meaning: A_t at step 0.

name: A_full_0
meaning: A_full at step 0.

name: A_peak
meaning: Largest A_t over the run.

name: A_peak_step
meaning: The step of A_peak.

name: memorised
meaning: True if the training accuracy reached 1 at some checkpoint. A run that never memorises has no grokking time, which is different from a censored one.

name: t_mem
meaning: First checkpoint at which the training accuracy is 1.

name: t_mem_prev
meaning: The checkpoint before t_mem, so the event lies in (t_mem_prev, t_mem].

name: t_gen_acc95
meaning: First checkpoint at which the test accuracy reaches 0.95.

name: t_gen_acc95_prev
meaning: The checkpoint before t_gen_acc95.

name: t_grok_acc95
meaning: Grokking time under the accuracy definition at test level 0.95: t_gen_acc95 - t_mem, or last_step - t_mem if censored. Empty if the run never memorised.

name: censored_acc95
meaning: True if the test accuracy never reached 0.95, or the run never memorised.

name: t_gen_acc99
